# artifactapi_local_docker (Resource)

Manages a local ArtifactAPI Docker repository — a real container registry serving the Docker Registry HTTP API V2 for push and pull.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artifactapi_local_docker" "internal" {
  name        = "docker-internal"
  description = "Internal container image registry"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the local Docker repository. Becomes the first path segment of pushed image references (e.g. <endpoint>/<name>/<image>:<tag>).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name.
terraform import artifactapi_local_docker.internal docker-internal
```
